newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast prods hold or ease with stable NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast prods hold or ease with stable NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. West Coast product prices held or edged down in subdued midday trade, in line with stable futures markets.
Trade faded, with dealers wary following volatile sessions and awaiting data from tonight's release of inventory data.
Late trade in New York saw near-month gasoline off a slight 0.52 cent a gallon to 62.35 cents, while October heating oil climbed 0.26 cent to 65.55 cents.
And local fundamentals were bullish, with key refiners recovering from recent shutdowns or preparing for scheduled maintenance next month.
